velocity.basis: Planning envelope with qualification buffer; prior attended-agent elapsed time is not productive engineering-day velocity.

acceptance_criteria: Validate the finite8/24 pilot and general bounded schedule, unique arms/IDs, stage requirements/oracles, native counterpart responsibilities, exact hashes and explicit model/harness/settings identities.
Reject traversal/absolute carried-artifact paths, symlinks/device files, duplicate JSON keys and conflicting ordinary-suite selection. Unmatched or altered stage contracts cannot silently compare.
Pin package source a4163559a2e20dddc1a1bb0869a06e42372994a1 and ledger v2. Registry0.1 lacks these APIs; never substitute it for unpublished0.2.

features.description: Opt-in CLI routing and zero-dispatch dry run
acceptance_criteria: --agent is required. --dry-run prints the complete resolved finite schedule, source/analysis identities and budget/isolation availability without creating executors, requesting credentials or calling a model/canary.
Reject ordinary benchmark/tier/lang/trial/condition/queue/browser/cohort flags when they would override the manifest; document the exact allowed common flags. Existing invocations preserve behavior.
Keep eval_suite.go below800 lines by extracting one cohesive existing helper, not shaving comments. CLI help describes only implemented behavior and an executable dry-run example.

features.description: Owned checkpoints and controlled workspace lifecycle
acceptance_criteria: A broken S1 is the exact source basis for S2; no reference/gold restoration. Missing required app files remain a model artifact failure, not a silently healed starter.
Carry only declared regular files; explicit tests cover symlink traversal, rename/delete, excluded logs/caches and create-only immutable output. Record actual copied manifests/hashes.
Reap child processes before grading/checkpoint finalization and on all error exits; preserve result artifacts and spent work while isolating build/runtime outputs per source identity.

Scripted execution accounts for every scheduled stage after failure, timeout, cancellation, invalid setup, budget stop and never-started dispatch. Stage schedule is fixed and failed spend never disappears.
Only the current requirement/public diagnostics reach the model. Controller oracle verdicts are withheld during the primary trajectory; future-stage source is not seeded early.
Write native-ledger-compatible rows with prior/candidate/check/oracle/attempt identities; blocked continuation keeps the last actual owned checkpoint. Do not add a generic workflow engine.

features.description: Grade arbitrary retained candidates with trusted task drivers
acceptance_criteria: Reference candidates pass and compiled semantic mutants fail on specific obligations. Deliberately uncompilable model source is an artifact/check failure; missing trusted tools/fixtures are invalid measurement setup, not model errors.
Trusted check/oracle source hashes cannot be weakened by agent edits. Reject mismatched input/output/source hashes, skipped assertions, stale builds, malformed typed output and overwritten evidence.

Grade in a clean runtime against all retained obligations. Candidate code cannot read or rewrite oracle expected values/controller data during execution; test that boundary rather than assuming the host oracle being outside the workspace is sufficient.

features.description: Reuse task construction and existing dispatch controls
acceptance_criteria: Task construction parity tests pin ordinary prompts/metadata/model/timeouts/pricing/env/tool behavior; no DEBUG_AGENT environment hack to preserve workspaces.
New stages use explicit isolated ambient-context/extensions requests and frozen prompt/profile/settings digests. Unsupported executor capabilities fail before model dispatch.
Do not grow agent_runner_multi.go(781) or motoko.go(770) past800 lines or change Motoko core. Register protected-mode support only on an actually qualified backend.

No-model tests cover real native read/write/edit/grep/find/ls surfaces, relative cwd != root, prefix confusion, symlink ancestors, unknown path shapes and protected developer files. Allowed native app work remains possible for both languages.

Only the declared canonical tool set and trusted extensions load; no ambient/global extension or context-file discovery. Protect policy/extension assets and controller/source-bank roots, including shared Git object stores and other trajectory workspaces.
First-backend selection is a proposal for this sprint, not a claim existing pi or Motoko is already qualified. Record effective tool/policy digest and refuse unmeasured boundaries.

features.description: Reuse bash sandbox and qualify the actual boundary
acceptance_criteria: An actual no-model process canary must fail to read protected oracle/reference/controller roots via cat, Python open, AILANG FS, symlink traversal and native tools; it must also refuse modifying developer/oracle evidence while ordinary app builds run.

Tool subprocess network cannot fetch reference solutions; inference stays in the existing executor. Qualify exact platform/tool versions and policy, fail closed if sandbox initialization/support is absent, and never infer universal host/holdout protection from a few checks.

Declare the protected-root threat boundary and require all known source/reference copies and Git stores in it. If existing primitives cannot meet it, keep live admission closed and raise a scoped extension design rather than launching weaker comparative trials. Ordinary executor paths remain unchanged.

features.description: Existing-parser leaf receipts and honest presence
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover absent versus explicit zero, inclusive/exclusive input, combined reasoning, incomplete streams, retries, compaction and summary/leaf reconciliation; no second provider-log parser in Go adapter or AILANG package.

Aggregate Result integers alone do not establish reported cache/reasoning zero or per-request completeness. Untraceable calls/overlap keep affected economics unavailable; retain original reported totals as source evidence.

Preserve raw decimal cost text when available. Never round float CostUSD to six decimals to fabricate exact money; unsupported precision remains explicit under current0.2 rules. Do not relabel registry estimates/subscription equivalents as metered invoices.

features.description: Use native package analysis for runner outputs
acceptance_criteria: A clean source-path consumer uses merged0.2 code explicitly until registry publication is authorized. Verify actual compiler/source/lock/tool identities and store external provenance; reportId remains declared, not self-attesting.

Independent known fixture reproduces185-test foundation expectations:8/24 coverage, cost delta-22500micros, fresh-input diagnostic-550, fresh+generated headline-540; all are labelled instrument controls.

Unknown/missing usage and invalid outcomes produce unavailable economic claims while valid correctness remains visible. Emit reference-linked reproduction cards/draft investigation material without approving roadmap code or claiming a language win.

features.description: Bounded no-model integration and failure matrix
acceptance_criteria: Plant broken early source, public-green semantic regressions, altered oracle, changed stage/provider/prompt identity, dropped costly retry, missing receipt, stale build, timeout and cancellation; each has an independent expected classification.
All24 rows and retained snapshots survive partial failure, and the model receives no private oracle feedback. Pipeline/source/receipt digests bind each actual artifact.
No paid canary/provider/model call is allowed in normal tests or dry-run. If platform containment is unavailable, report the admission gap explicitly and do not mark its criterion passed with a skip.

features.description: Focused gates, help/docs and independent evaluation
acceptance_criteria: Run focused Go/executor/CLI tests, make test-changed plus test-core, lint/file-size/boundary and pi-asset gates; TS guard tests and actual no-model OS checks are separate recorded outcomes. No full Go suite executor gate.
Native package tests/properties/examples/quality/dry-run remain green without new warning allowlists or formatter exclusions; original frozen studies are unchanged.

Publish reviewable source PRs only after concrete checks, then independent sprint-evaluator review; complete all state/plan criteria in the same trees. Exact model/provider/rates/enforceable bounds and actual launch authorization remain a later explicit decision.
